The acorn source has 15 observed units, but its edibility and preparation requirements are not established. Exterior observation alone cannot establish safety.

preferences: Prioritize locating evidenced food sources before spending substantial time on material experiments.
Do not ingest unfamiliar acorns, fungi, or nuts on the basis of names or exterior appearance.

args.function: Provide a learnable physical assessment of the nearby actual plum source forest-plum-2, distinguishing available identification and preparation evidence from unresolved ingestion hazards. Determine whether existing personal food knowledge supports consumption; if not, identify what additional evidence or feasible preparation trial is needed. Exterior appearance alone must not certify safety, and no ingestion is authorized by this request.
args.conditions: At tick 234 Lin is at (13.09545879,22.65592905), health 100, satiety 25.4 and energy 30.38. The plum source at (13.2,23.3) visibly has stock 18 and is mature. This observation establishes availability, not food safety. Nearby known berry and meadow-root sources were last observed empty. Actual approach or specimen collection must be separately executed if required.
args.inputs: Actual source forest-plum-2; Lin's existing personal evidence; an actual collected specimen only if subsequently required and obtained. No specimen is currently owned.
args.costs: Method, duration and energy costs are unknown; disclose bounded prerequisites and costs before execution.
args.effects: Return only supported findings, explicit limitations, and actionable next prerequisites. Do not create food, infer safety from labels, award wellbeing, or claim that requesting or studying completes a physical assessment.

reviews.reason: The related capabilities have been searched. bounded-unfamiliar-food-assessment and bounded-hazelnut-food-assessment provide the relevant evidence-limited reporting machinery, but their execution contracts require different exact owned specimens. Neither authorizes examination of the standing forest-plum-2 source, and Lin owns no plum specimen. Develop the smallest source-bound, nondestructive assessment precursor in the existing current-conversation handoff, recording reuse of those implementations rather than claiming reinvention. The supplied records do not establish plum identification, sufficient preparation or ingestion safety; this is an evidence limitation, not a permanent rejection of further investigation. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Personal learning costs one active round and 0.2 energy and grants no experience reward merely for study, registration, requesting or completion of a report. This minimal precursor exposes existing public metadata and evidence limitations rather than a newly modeled food property, so it awards zero pleasure, maintained satisfaction, comfort or nutrition. No satiety, health, energy restoration or protected reward-account, budget, goal or permission changes. A future implemented observation may qualify only for an established coded reward rule after a genuinely verified personally applicable finding, including informative physical failure, with explicit bounded amount/cap, decay, cooldown and canonical source/property/state deduplication across methods; absent such a rule, reward remains zero. Merely restating uncertainty or an implementation limitation is not information gain.
reviews.visualReview: Reuse the existing source plant visual without creating fruit, changing its ready state to imply edibility or adding a safety badge. On committed examination emit an observation event with actor, source ID, source revision, tick, method/version, observed-state fingerprint, evidence references and private report ID. Supply reusable report metadata such as component=assessment-report, subject=forest-plum-2, state=completed-evidence-limited, safetyStatus=unresolved unless genuinely supported evidence warrants a narrower conclusion, and label=Source assessment; observation completion must remain distinct from food-safety success. Detailed personal findings remain private until actual communication. Invalid, interrupted or canceled actions may display their actual status but never a completed inspection or safe-food effect. Visual feedback provides no separate functional or experiential reward.
reviews.specification: Implement AssessSource(sourceId=forest-plum-2,evidenceRefs=[]) for Lin. Reuse and record the access validation, complete-personal-evidence handling, append-only private reports and atomic transaction machinery of bounded-unfamiliar-food-assessment and bounded-hazelnut-food-assessment; add only standing-source applicability and source revision checks. Before execution disclose: one active world round and 0.2 energy, no material consumption, plus any separately executed approach cost. Require a living actor, sufficient energy, current unobstructed local observation and reach under the existing interaction-distance rule at execution; do not assume the tick-234 position satisfies that rule. No travel is bundled. Accept at most eight distinct exact personally accessible complete evidence record keys. The supplied paged fragments are not complete evidence: unavailable, incomplete or unrelated records must be marked accordingly, never silently reconstructed or treated as negative findings. No other person's private knowledge or hidden resource properties may be read. Refer explicitly to forest-plum-2, its foundation-forest@1 revision, the execution tick/current observed state, and every evidence key actually used. The tick-234 observation supports reported mature stage and visible availability of 18 only as dated availability evidence, not current guaranteed stock or food suitability. Actual execution reobserves accessible public state and only represented visible properties. Names, resource labels, color, maturity and stock cannot establish botanical identity, edible portions, toxin absence, preparation sufficiency or nutrition. Produce a private dated report separating direct observations, supplied evidence and its scope, supported conclusions, unavailable properties and unresolved ingestion hazards. Report whether the complete available personal evidence supports consumption; with inadequate evidence return 'not established', not 'poisonous' or 'safe'. Identify the specific missing identity/source-applicability and preparation evidence. Existing consult/message/exchange may obtain evidence only through independently acting actual participants. If closer specimen examination is necessary, report separately executed approach and collection as prerequisites; no specimen is created or reserved by assessment. Do not prescribe a heat, washing, opening or tasting procedure as sufficient without supported source-specific evidence. Any justified missing preparation or observation mechanism returns to the current-conversation development handoff for a bounded executable trial with actual inputs, costs, hazards and conserved outputs; it is neither automatically performed nor assigned an era unlock. This precursor has no tasting, ingestion, cutting, gathering, opening, heat or manipulation and cannot certify unavailable features. Preserve source stock, all item quantities, ownership, location and condition; normal ageing and ordinary world rules continue only during actual execution. Output is an informational record and committed observation event, not food or a physical marker. Validate access, references and energy before charging; invalid attempts produce no successful assessment. Use an atomic one-round commit with unique execution identity to prevent duplicate charges/events. No partial work, escrow, locks, passive process, maintenance or automatic refresh. Precommit interruption, cancellation or death produces no assessment charge or completed report; after commit the paid effort is not refundable and the dated record remains subject to ordinary persistence rules. Repeats require new paid execution and retain prior reports. Learning/development does not execute an assessment, grant mastery, change permissions or advance world time while awaiting development/review. Encode these checks and outcomes in the implementation rather than requiring repeated model adjudication.
